set.request: A deletion task: ext/Panel's workspace.js back under 200 lines with no capability lost — the first objective is clean, simple solutions Mike can open and understand.
steps: Read workspace.js and name its distinct responsibilities
Extract by responsibility, not by line count
Docs and readme follow the new shape

links.label: Files tab — the four new notes

set.outcome:
**workspace.js 365 -> 198 lines, four responsibilities extracted, nothing changed.**

`ext/Panel/workspace.js` now holds only the two doors, the redraw and the recursive `view()`. What came out, each named for what it is and each read by `workspace.js` without reading it back:

| file | lines | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| [`vocab.js`](/framework/ext/Panel/files/) | 28 | what a document was opened with — `vocab`/`offer`/`standard` and the `tools` flag resolver |
| [`focus.js`](/framework/ext/Panel/files/) | 61 | the selection, and the three ways it is lost |
| [`overlays.js`](/framework/ext/Panel/files/) | 49 | the four surfaces on a leaf body, and the disposer registry `draw()` drains |
| [`paint.js`](/framework/ext/Panel/files/) | 76 | one panel's own DOM — `paint`/`repaint`/`show`/`views`, and the mirror walk |

Module total 2,582 -> 2,631 (+49, all of it file headers). The public door is unchanged — `workspace.js` re-exports `vocab`/`tools`/`focused`/`repaint`/`show`, so `ext/files/panels.js` and `properties.js` were not touched.

**Proof nothing changed.** Per-workspace surface census byte-identical before and after on [`/full/`](/framework/ext/Panel/full/) (9 mounts), [`/framework/ext/Panel/`](/framework/ext/Panel/) (8) and [`ext/editor`](/framework/ext/editor/) (2): main mount 54 panels, 34 bodies, 34 align grids, 136 edge zones, 20 insert bars, 34 display overlays, 34 zoom buttons, 15 repeat tiles. ext/editor's own workspace still draws 0 align / 0 edge / 0 insert / 0 display / 0 zoom. Observers flat across 20 structural redraws, before and after: 96 MutationObservers + 59 ResizeObservers live on `/full/`, with all 34 bodies provably rebuilt each pass. Zero console errors on six pages. `/data/panels.json` untouched.

![](shot.png)

**Left deliberately:** `roll()` and the `drawing` flag stayed together in `workspace.js` — a flag with two users cannot be split without an import in one direction. The duplicated dev/localStorage saver chooser (3 sites) is still open; it belongs in `ext/Saver`, outside this task's fence.
